title: HAM-RAG: Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG for Structure-Faithful Interleaved Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14032v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing multimodal RAG methods often flatten structured documents into isolated text and image units, weakening the source organization and local text-image logic needed for faithful evidence selection and placement. We propose HAM-RAG, a Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG framework for structure-faithful interleaved generation. HAM-RAG uses document hierarchy as a grounding signal across retrieval and generation, contextualizing textual and visual evidence and preserving source position and local text-image relations in the prompt. We further introduce HAM-Bench, covering Wukong, Wiki, arXiv, and Recipe across game walkthroughs, web pages, scientific papers, and step-wise recipe documents. Across multiple backbones, HAM-RAG improves the main multimodal average by 17.3% over the strongest non-hierarchical baseline. On Wukong, HAM-RAG improves Img-CBS by 24.2% over the strongest non-hierarchical baseline, demonstrating substantially better

translated_title: HAM-RAG：面向结构忠实交错生成的分层感知多模态RAG框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14032v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：现有的多模态RAG方法通常将结构化文档扁平化为孤立的文本和图像单元，削弱了源组织以及局部文本-图像逻辑，而这些对于忠实的证据选择和放置至关重要。我们提出HAM-RAG，一种用于结构忠实交错生成的分层感知多模态RAG框架。HAM-RAG利用文档层级作为检索和生成过程中的基础信号，将文本和视觉证据情境化，并在提示中保留源位置和局部文本-图像关系。我们进一步引入HAM-Bench，涵盖悟空、维基、arXiv和食谱，覆盖游戏攻略、网页、科学论文和逐步食谱文档。在多个骨干模型上，HAM-RAG相对于最强的非分层基线，在多模态平均指标上提升了17.3%。在悟空数据集上，HAM-RAG在Img-CBS指标上相对于最强的非分层基线提升了24.2%，显示出显著更优的性能。
tldr: HAM-RAG通过利用文档层级结构作为检索和生成的引导信号，显著提升了多模态交错生成的忠实性和证据放置准确性，在多个数据集上超越了非分层基线。
en_tdlr: HAM-RAG leverages document hierarchy as a grounding signal for retrieval and generation, substantially improving faithfulness and evidence placement in multimodal interleaved generation, outperforming non-hierarchical baselines across multiple datasets.
